'''Borm''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], he sold specialized gear for [[Sith Warrior]]s in the Combat Training section of [[Vaiken Spacedock]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Borm.png|thumb|200px|Borm former appearance]]
Borm first appeared in the video game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a level 50 Battlemaster PVP Gear vendor. He was later removed in Game Update 5.0 on [[November 29]], [[2016]], which retired the PvP and PvE gear vendors in favor of the Command system.<ref name="5.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/11292016/game-update-5.0-knights-eternal-throne-early-access|text=Game Update 5.0: Knights of the Eternal Throne Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref> A later update added him back, with different gear and without any function.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
